segments.t: And given everything that happened in the last year, I asked Masasana about the biggest lessons that he had learned and what he's expecting.
We had a we work issues. We had a green sale. We had the capital. You know, we have many bad investment we made.
I hope the we work is turning around now and become a visibility with profitability sometime in the next several quarters.
So many regrets of bad investment, but actually more regrets in missing a great company's investment.
So that is even bigger regrets.
OK, so hold on. So who do you think you missed? I know we've had conversations before about Jeff Bezos and Amazon and things like that.
But is there is there is there a more recent misses of their companies that you wish you had invested in even the last couple of years?
Yeah, yeah, yeah. So Airbnb, Snowflake and several other companies that we should have invested. We were looking to invest and I was not smart enough.
When you look back and say to yourself, OK, Airbnb, I didn't see it.
What do you see now that you think you should have seen? And are there lessons in that?
Well, I saw that they are pretty good company, a great business model, great time and so on.
I thought the price was a little too expensive. We were discussing to invest, but I was not smart enough to accept the price tag that they had.
Couple of years ago, you know, so so lots of regret.
